text:
The bowl looks like a small one, about 12-15 cm across. It holds what looks like one or two large green (spinach) dumplings or wontons in red chili oil sauce with herbs.

A single large dumpling weighs about 30-40 g. Two would be about 70 g. The sauce adds roughly 20-30 g of chili oil and soy. That gives a total of about 100 g.

Energy: the dumplings come to about 100 kcal, and the sauce with oil adds about 60 kcal, so roughly 160 kcal.
